t.en: The basis: pray as you saw him pray
t.ms: Asasnya: solatlah seperti kamu melihat Baginda solat

s.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Pray as you have seen me praying" (Bukhari 631). When a man prayed badly, he taught him the pillars: takbir, recite, bow until at rest, stand up straight, prostrate until at rest, sit until at rest, prostrate again, and do this in the whole prayer (the hadith of 'the man who prayed badly', Bukhari 757, Muslim 885). Being at rest (tuma'ninah) in each position is part of the prayer itself.
s.ms: Nabi ﷺ bersabda: "Solatlah kamu sebagaimana kamu melihat aku solat" (Bukhari 631). Apabila seorang lelaki solat dengan tidak sempurna, Baginda mengajarnya rukun-rukunnya: takbir, membaca, rukuk hingga tenang, bangun hingga lurus, sujud hingga tenang, duduk hingga tenang, sujud lagi, dan lakukan begitu dalam seluruh solat (hadis 'orang yang buruk solatnya', Bukhari 757, Muslim 885). Tenang (tuma'ninah) dalam setiap rukun ialah sebahagian daripada solat itu sendiri.

h.en: The back must be at rest in bowing and prostration
h.ms: Belakang mesti tenang ketika rukuk dan sujud

s.en: Every prayer needs an intention: which prayer you are praying. All scholars agree the intention is in the heart.
s.ms: Setiap solat memerlukan niat: solat apa yang sedang dilakukan. Semua ulama sepakat niat itu di dalam hati.

p.en: Later Shafi'i scholars consider saying it with the tongue recommended, to help the heart; the intention itself stays in the heart.
p.ms: Ulama Syafi'i terkemudian menganggap melafazkannya sunat, untuk membantu hati; niat itu sendiri tetap di dalam hati.

p.en: Not prescribed: saying it aloud is an innovation; the intention is in the heart.
p.ms: Tidak disyariatkan: melafazkannya adalah bid'ah; niat di dalam hati.

p.en: Not prescribed; the intention is in the heart.
p.ms: Tidak disyariatkan; niat di dalam hati.

note.en: No hadith reports the Prophet ﷺ saying an intention for prayer aloud; the difference is whether doing so is a helpful practice.
note.ms: Tiada hadis yang meriwayatkan Nabi ﷺ melafazkan niat solat; perbezaannya ialah sama ada melakukannya amalan yang membantu.

t.en: Opening takbir and raising the hands

s.en: He began the prayer with "Allahu akbar", raising his hands to the level of his shoulders, and in other reports to his ears.
s.ms: Baginda memulakan solat dengan "Allahu akbar" sambil mengangkat kedua tangan setentang bahu, dan dalam riwayat lain setentang telinga.

t.en: Placing the right hand on the left
t.ms: Meletakkan tangan kanan di atas tangan kiri (bersedekap)

s.en: People were told to place the right hand on the left forearm in the prayer (Bukhari 740). Wa'il ibn Hujr saw him place his right hand on his left (Muslim 896). Where the hands are placed is where scholars differ.
s.ms: Orang ramai diperintah meletakkan tangan kanan di atas lengan kiri dalam solat (Bukhari 740). Wa'il bin Hujr melihat Baginda meletakkan tangan kanan di atas tangan kiri (Muslim 896). Di mana tangan diletakkan, di situlah ulama berbeza.

h.en: He moved Ibn Mas'ud's right hand onto his left
h.ms: Baginda memindahkan tangan kanan Ibn Mas'ud ke atas tangan kirinya

p.en: Below the chest, above the navel.
p.ms: Di bawah dada, di atas pusat.

p.en: Below the navel (for men).
p.ms: Di bawah pusat (bagi lelaki).

p.en: Below the navel, in the best-known report from Ahmad; he also allowed above it.
p.ms: Di bawah pusat, menurut riwayat yang masyhur daripada Ahmad; beliau juga membenarkan di atasnya.

p.en: The best-known view in the school is to let the hands hang down in obligatory prayers; others in the school hold them as the majority do.
p.ms: Pendapat masyhur mazhab ialah melepaskan tangan di sisi dalam solat fardu; sebahagian ulama mazhab bersedekap seperti jumhur.

p.en: Our school: below the chest, above the navel. He also quotes Ibn al-Mundhir: nothing is established from the Prophet ﷺ on the exact place, so one may choose.
p.ms: Mazhab kami: di bawah dada, di atas pusat. Beliau juga memetik Ibn al-Mundzir: tiada yang sabit daripada Nabi ﷺ tentang tempatnya yang tepat, jadi seseorang boleh memilih.

p.en: Hulb at-Ta'i's hadith (Musnad Ahmad): sahih li-ghayrihi, except the words 'he placed this on his chest'.
p.ms: Hadis Hulb at-Ta'i (Musnad Ahmad): sahih li-ghairihi, kecuali lafaz 'Baginda meletakkan ini di atas dadanya'.

h.en: Tawus (a Successor, mursal): on the chest

note.en: The reports naming a place are all disputed: see the gradings on each. 'On the chest' from Wa'il ibn Hujr is in Sahih Ibn Khuzaymah, and from Hulb at-Ta'i in Musnad Ahmad (not in this app's books).
note.ms: Riwayat yang menyebut tempatnya semuanya dipertikaikan: lihat penilaian setiap satu. 'Di atas dada' daripada Wa'il bin Hujr ada dalam Sahih Ibn Khuzaimah, dan daripada Hulb at-Ta'i dalam Musnad Ahmad (bukan dalam kitab aplikasi ini).

s.en: He said a short supplication silently before reciting. Several wordings are authentic: 'Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya…' (Bukhari 744), 'Wajjahtu wajhiya…' (Muslim, in the night prayer), and 'Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika…' (Abu Dawud 776, and 'Umar said it aloud to teach it, Muslim 892).
s.ms: Baginda membaca doa pendek secara perlahan sebelum membaca Al-Fatihah. Beberapa lafaz adalah sahih: 'Allahumma ba'id baini wa baina khatayaya…' (Bukhari 744), 'Wajjahtu wajhiya…' (Muslim, dalam solat malam), dan 'Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika…' (Abu Dawud 776, dan 'Umar menyaringkannya untuk mengajar, Muslim 892).

p.en: 'Wajjahtu wajhiya…'.

p.en: Any of the authentic wordings, varying between them.

s.en: He sought refuge in Allah before reciting (Abu Dawud 775). Anas said the Prophet ﷺ, Abu Bakr and 'Umar began the recitation with 'Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin' (Bukhari 743); in Muslim's wording they did not mention (aloud) 'Bismillah…' (Muslim 892). Whether it is said aloud is where scholars differ.
s.ms: Baginda memohon perlindungan Allah sebelum membaca (Abu Dawud 775). Anas berkata Nabi ﷺ, Abu Bakar dan 'Umar memulakan bacaan dengan 'Al-hamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin' (Bukhari 743); dalam lafaz Muslim mereka tidak menyebut (dengan kuat) 'Bismillah…' (Muslim 892). Sama ada ia dibaca kuat, di situlah ulama berbeza.

topic.ms: Basmalah dibaca kuat dalam solat jahar

p.en: It is a verse of al-Fatihah and is said aloud where the recitation is aloud.
p.ms: Ia satu ayat daripada Al-Fatihah dan dibaca kuat apabila bacaan dikuatkan.

p.en: Saying it aloud is the view of most scholars from the Companions onward.
p.ms: Menguatkannya ialah pendapat kebanyakan ulama sejak para Sahabat.
p.ref: al-Nawawi, al-Majmu' Sharh al-Muhadhdhab 3/208, as cited by Ibn Sarkand, al-Ahkam al-Fiqhiyyah allati qila fiha bin-naskh 2/832

p.en: Said quietly; saying it aloud sometimes is allowed.

h.en: Nu'aym al-Mujmir: Abu Hurairah recited it (aloud) and said his prayer was most like the Prophet's
h.ms: Nu'aim al-Mujmir: Abu Hurairah membacanya (kuat) dan berkata solatnya paling menyerupai solat Nabi

s.en: "There is no prayer for whoever does not recite al-Fatihah" (Bukhari 756, Muslim 874). After it the imam and those behind him say 'Amin'; "whoever's amin coincides with the angels' amin, his past sins are forgiven" (Bukhari 780).
s.ms: "Tiada solat bagi sesiapa yang tidak membaca Al-Fatihah" (Bukhari 756, Muslim 874). Selepasnya imam dan makmum menyebut 'Amin'; "sesiapa yang aminnya bersamaan dengan amin malaikat, diampunkan dosanya yang lalu" (Bukhari 780).

p.en: Obligatory for everyone, including behind the imam in loud prayers.
p.ms: Wajib bagi setiap orang, termasuk makmum dalam solat jahar.

p.en: The follower does not recite; the imam's recitation counts for him.
p.ms: Makmum tidak membaca; bacaan imam memadai baginya.

p.en: The follower recites in quiet prayers and listens in loud ones.
p.ms: Makmum membaca dalam solat sirr dan mendengar dalam solat jahar.

p.en: The follower recites in quiet prayers and listens in loud ones.
p.ms: Makmum membaca dalam solat sirr dan mendengar dalam solat jahar.

p.en: Al-Fatihah is required: the prayer of anyone able to recite it is not valid without it. (3/364 records the school's old view that the follower does not recite in loud prayers.)
p.ms: Al-Fatihah wajib: solat orang yang mampu membacanya tidak sah tanpanya. (3/364 mencatat pendapat lama mazhab bahawa makmum tidak membaca dalam solat jahar.)

p.en: The follower listens in loud prayers and recites in quiet ones.
p.ms: Makmum mendengar dalam solat jahar dan membaca dalam solat sirr.
p.ref: al-Albani, Sifat Salat an-Nabi p. 97 (loud prayers); al-Albani, Asl Sifat Salat an-Nabi 3/1055 (quiet prayers)

p.en: Obligatory for the follower too, in loud prayers as well (in the imam's pauses or quietly while he recites).
p.ms: Wajib juga bagi makmum, termasuk dalam solat jahar (ketika imam berhenti atau perlahan semasa imam membaca).

p.en: Obligatory on the imam, the follower and one praying alone in quiet prayers, except a latecomer who catches the bowing.
p.ms: Wajib bagi imam, makmum dan orang yang solat bersendirian dalam solat sirr, kecuali makmum masbuq yang sempat rukuk.
p.ref: Ibn 'Uthaymin, Fath Dhi al-Jalal wa al-Ikram 2/70

h.en: 'Has any of you recited with me?' (after a loud prayer)
h.ms: 'Adakah sesiapa antara kamu membaca bersamaku?' (selepas solat jahar)

s.en: He said the takbir and bowed, with his back level, head neither raised nor lowered (Muslim 1110, Bukhari 828). In bowing he said 'Subhana Rabbiyal-'Azim' (Muslim 1814) and also 'Subhanakallahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahummaghfir li' (Muslim 1085).
s.ms: Baginda bertakbir dan rukuk dengan belakang rata, kepala tidak diangkat dan tidak direndahkan (Muslim 1110, Bukhari 828). Dalam rukuk Baginda membaca 'Subhana Rabbiyal-'Azim' (Muslim 1814) dan juga 'Subhanakallahumma Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahummaghfir li' (Muslim 1085).

p.en: Recommended when bowing and rising; al-Nawawi held it is also recommended when standing up after the first tashahhud, following Bukhari 739.
p.ms: Sunat ketika rukuk dan bangkit; al-Nawawi berpendapat ia juga sunat ketika bangun selepas tasyahhud awal, berdasarkan Bukhari 739.

p.ms: Mengangkat tangan ketika bangun daripada tasyahhud awal adalah sunat: 'inilah yang betul' (وهذا هو الصواب).

s.en: He rose saying 'Sami'allahu liman hamidah', then 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd', standing straight until every bone returned to its place (Bukhari 734, Bukhari 828).
s.ms: Baginda bangkit sambil membaca 'Sami'allahu liman hamidah', kemudian 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd', berdiri lurus hingga setiap tulang kembali ke tempatnya (Bukhari 734, Bukhari 828).

s.en: He prostrated on seven bones: the forehead with the nose, the two hands, the two knees and the ends of the two feet (Bukhari 812), keeping his arms away from his sides. In prostration he said 'Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la' (Muslim 1814).
s.ms: Baginda sujud di atas tujuh anggota: dahi bersama hidung, dua tapak tangan, dua lutut dan hujung dua kaki (Bukhari 812), dengan lengan direnggangkan dari rusuk. Dalam sujud Baginda membaca 'Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la' (Muslim 1814).

s.en: He sat on his left foot with the right foot upright (Bukhari 828) and stayed until at rest, saying 'Rabbighfir li, Rabbighfir li' (Nasa'i 1145, Abu Dawud 874) or 'Allahummaghfir li warhamni…' (Abu Dawud 850, Tirmidhi 284).
s.ms: Baginda duduk di atas kaki kiri dengan kaki kanan ditegakkan (Bukhari 828) dan kekal hingga tenang, sambil membaca 'Rabbighfir li, Rabbighfir li' (Nasa'i 1145, Abu Dawud 874) atau 'Allahummaghfir li warhamni…' (Abu Dawud 850, Tirmidhi 284).

s.en: Malik ibn al-Huwayrith saw that in the odd rak'ahs (the first and third) he did not stand up until he had sat upright (Bukhari 823).
s.ms: Malik bin al-Huwairith melihat bahawa pada rakaat ganjil (pertama dan ketiga) Baginda tidak bangun sehingga duduk dengan sempurna (Bukhari 823).

p.ms: Hadis Mu'awiyah 'Jangan mendahuluiku dalam rukuk dan sujud, kerana badanku sudah berat' (dalil mereka yang berkata Baginda duduk kerana keperluan): sahih li-ghairihi.

s.en: After two rak'ahs he sat on his left foot with the right upright (Bukhari 828), placed his hands on his thighs, closed the fingers of the right hand and pointed with the index finger (Muslim 1311), and recited the tashahhud: 'At-tahiyyatu lillah, was-salawatu wat-tayyibat…' (Ibn Mas'ud, Bukhari 831; Ibn 'Abbas's wording, Muslim 902).
s.ms: Selepas dua rakaat Baginda duduk di atas kaki kiri dengan kaki kanan ditegakkan (Bukhari 828), meletakkan tangan di atas paha, menggenggam jari tangan kanan dan menunjuk dengan jari telunjuk (Muslim 1311), dan membaca tasyahhud: 'At-tahiyyatu lillah, was-salawatu wat-tayyibat…' (Ibn Mas'ud, Bukhari 831; lafaz Ibn 'Abbas, Muslim 902).

p.ms: Ditunjukkan setiap kali nama Allah disebut, tanpa digerakkan.

p.en: Moving the finger is not prescribed in the tashahhud (the Shafi'i school).

p.en: Graded sahih Wa'il's hadith with the words 'moving it, supplicating with it' (Nasa'i 889).
p.ms: Menilai sahih hadis Wa'il dengan lafaz 'menggerakkannya, berdoa dengannya' (Nasa'i 889).
p.ref: al-Albani graded Wa'il's hadith ('moving it') sahih (Sahih an-Nasa'i)

p.en: Pointed, and moved each time one supplicates in the tashahhud.
p.ms: Ditunjukkan, dan digerakkan setiap kali berdoa dalam tasyahhud.

h.en: Wa'il: 'I saw him moving it, supplicating with it'
h.ms: Wa'il: 'Aku melihat Baginda menggerakkannya, berdoa dengannya'

h.en: Ibn az-Zubayr: 'and he did not move it'

note.en: Many scholars consider the word 'moving it' in Wa'il's hadith a wording only one narrator added (shadhdh); al-Albani accepted it. 'And he did not move it' is graded weak.
note.ms: Ramai ulama menganggap perkataan 'menggerakkannya' dalam hadis Wa'il sebagai tambahan seorang perawi sahaja (syaz); al-Albani menerimanya. 'Dan tidak menggerakkannya' dinilai lemah.

t.en: The final tashahhud, salawat and supplication

s.en: In the last sitting he put his left foot forward, kept the right upright and sat on his seat (tawarruk) (Bukhari 828). After the tashahhud comes the salawat on the Prophet ﷺ ('Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad…', Bukhari 6357), then seeking refuge from four things: the punishment of Hell, the punishment of the grave, the trial of life and death, and the trial of the Dajjal (Muslim 1326), and any supplication, such as the one he taught Abu Bakr (Bukhari 834).
s.ms: Pada duduk terakhir Baginda mengeluarkan kaki kiri ke hadapan, menegakkan kaki kanan dan duduk di atas punggung (tawarruk) (Bukhari 828). Selepas tasyahhud ialah selawat ke atas Nabi ﷺ ('Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad…', Bukhari 6357), kemudian memohon perlindungan daripada empat perkara: azab neraka, azab kubur, fitnah hidup dan mati, dan fitnah Dajjal (Muslim 1326), dan apa-apa doa, seperti doa yang Baginda ajarkan kepada Abu Bakar (Bukhari 834).

p.en: The final sitting of every prayer, including two-rak'ah prayers such as Subuh.
p.ms: Duduk terakhir setiap solat, termasuk solat dua rakaat seperti Subuh.

p.en: Only the final sitting of a prayer that has two tashahhuds.
p.ms: Hanya duduk terakhir solat yang mempunyai dua tasyahhud.

p.en: Neither: both sittings on the left foot (for men).
p.ms: Tidak: kedua-dua duduk di atas kaki kiri (bagi lelaki).

p.en: Both sittings.
p.ms: Kedua-dua duduk.

s.en: He ended the prayer with 'As-salamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah' to the right and to the left, turning until the whiteness of his cheek was seen (Muslim 1315, Tirmidhi 295).
s.ms: Baginda mengakhiri solat dengan 'As-salamu 'alaikum wa rahmatullah' ke kanan dan ke kiri, berpaling hingga kelihatan putih pipinya (Muslim 1315, Tirmidhi 295).

p.en: Two; the first is a pillar, the second a sunnah.
p.ms: Dua; yang pertama rukun, yang kedua sunat.

p.en: Two, both required in obligatory prayers.
p.ms: Dua, kedua-duanya wajib dalam solat fardu.

p.en: Two.
p.ms: Dua.

p.en: One, for the imam and one praying alone.
p.ms: Satu, bagi imam dan orang yang solat bersendirian.

s.en: The Prophet ﷺ made qunut (a standing supplication after rising from bowing) in Subuh and other prayers at times of calamity, for a month (Muslim 1548, Bukhari 4090). Whether qunut is made in every Subuh is a well-known difference.
s.ms: Nabi ﷺ berqunut (doa ketika berdiri selepas bangkit daripada rukuk) dalam Subuh dan solat lain ketika musibah, selama sebulan (Muslim 1548, Bukhari 4090). Sama ada qunut dibaca dalam setiap Subuh ialah perbezaan yang terkenal.

h.en: Anas was asked: did he make qunut in Fajr? 'Yes', after bowing, for a short time
h.ms: Anas ditanya: adakah Baginda berqunut dalam Subuh? 'Ya', selepas rukuk, untuk tempoh yang singkat

h.en: Al-Bara': he made qunut in Subh and Maghrib
h.ms: Al-Bara': Baginda berqunut dalam Subuh dan Maghrib

p.en: A confirmed sunnah, after rising from the bowing of the second rak'ah.
p.ms: Sunat muakkad, selepas bangkit daripada rukuk rakaat kedua.

p.en: Recommended, said quietly, before bowing.
p.ms: Sunat, dibaca perlahan, sebelum rukuk.

p.en: Not in Subuh, except at times of calamity in some views; qunut is in witr.
p.ms: Tidak dalam Subuh, kecuali ketika musibah menurut sebahagian pendapat; qunut dalam witir.

p.en: Not in Subuh, except at times of calamity.
p.ms: Tidak dalam Subuh, kecuali ketika musibah.

p.en: Only at times of calamity.
p.ms: Hanya ketika musibah.

p.en: Only at times of calamity.
p.ms: Hanya ketika musibah.

p.en: Abu Mijlaz's report that he prayed Fajr behind Ibn 'Umar and Ibn 'Umar did not make qunut: hasan.
p.ms: Riwayat Abu Mijlaz bahawa beliau solat Subuh di belakang Ibn 'Umar dan Ibn 'Umar tidak berqunut: hasan.

h.en: Abu Malik al-Ashja'i's father: 'My son, it is something newly begun'
h.ms: Bapa Abu Malik al-Asyja'i: 'Wahai anakku, ia perkara baharu'

note.en: The Shafi'is also cite Anas: 'He kept making qunut in Fajr until he left this world' (Musnad Ahmad 12657; al-Hakim, al-Arba'in; al-Bayhaqi, as-Sunan al-Kubra 2/201; not in this app's books). Judged weak by Ibn al-Jawzi (al-'Ilal al-Mutanahiyah 1/444), Ibn Taymiyyah (Majmu' al-Fatawa 22/374), Ibn al-Qayyim (Zad al-Ma'ad 1/99), Ibn Hajar (at-Talkhis al-Habir 1/245), al-Albani (as-Silsilah ad-Da'ifah 1238) and Ibn Baz (Fatawa Nur 'ala ad-Darb 10/227), as listed by IslamQA 101015 and Dorar.net.
note.ms: Mazhab Syafi'i juga berhujah dengan riwayat Anas: 'Baginda sentiasa berqunut dalam Subuh hingga Baginda meninggalkan dunia' (Musnad Ahmad 12657; al-Hakim, al-Arba'in; al-Baihaqi, as-Sunan al-Kubra 2/201; bukan dalam kitab aplikasi ini). Dinilai lemah oleh Ibn al-Jauzi (al-'Ilal al-Mutanahiyah 1/444), Ibn Taimiyyah (Majmu' al-Fatawa 22/374), Ibn al-Qayyim (Zad al-Ma'ad 1/99), Ibn Hajar (at-Talkhis al-Habir 1/245), al-Albani (as-Silsilah adh-Dha'ifah 1238) dan Ibn Baz (Fatawa Nur 'ala ad-Darb 10/227), seperti yang disenaraikan oleh IslamQA 101015 dan Dorar.net.
